item.title: Royal experts analyze Prince Harry and Meghan's potential return to UK
item.description: Royal commentators Robert Jobson and Victoria Murphy discussed the implications of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's possible move back to the United Kingdom.

item.title: FBI seizes Eric Swalwell's devices in sexual misconduct investigation
item.description: The FBI seized former Rep. Eric Swalwell's electronic devices over the weekend as part of a criminal investigation into sexual misconduct allegations.

item.title: New details emerge on Trump's Kennedy Center and ballroom plans
item.description: Recent court filings reveal more about the ongoing work at the Kennedy Center and the White House ballroom project.

item.title: State Department says China wrongfully detains US citizen
item.description: The State Department announced Thursday that an American citizen in China has been illegally detained by the Chinese government.
